_comment: Ceilings and baseline consumed by verify-deploy.sh Gate 20 (orchestrator context budget lock). Two per-file ceilings are fixed/reviewed ROADMAP.md-derived targets (not headroom-derived from measured_bytes, unlike claudemd-size-budget.json's formula). Promotion of ORCHESTRATOR_BUDGET_GATE_MODE from warn to hard was attempted on 2026-10-01 once the sibling task concurrently editing commands/orchestrate.md (the `[HOLD]` status-marker change) had landed: skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md and the eager-load total were both brought under their ceiling by a deliberate duplication trim (see each file's own derivation and eager_load.note below), never by moving a ceiling or baseline_bytes. But that same landed sibling commit grew commands/orchestrate.md itself to 21,328 B, 328 B over its own 21,000 B ceiling -- a newly-discovered overage unrelated to and out of scope for the task that ran this trim (commands/orchestrate.md was not in that task's file_scope). ORCHESTRATOR_BUDGET_GATE_MODE therefore remains warn-tier pending a follow-up trim of commands/orchestrate.md; see that file's own derivation for the restatement-trim opportunity already on record there. eager_load.baseline_bytes is a fixed historical record (2026-09-02) copied verbatim from the task description that introduced this gate -- re-measure with 'REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash scripts/measure-eager-context.sh --check' and re-derive only baseline_bytes deliberately (it is the regression ceiling, not a rolling target); measured_bytes/measured_at fields are informational snapshots and may be refreshed freely.

skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md.derivation: ROADMAP.md 'Budgets' target ceiling. Pre-removal measurement (this task's own baseline) was 21,317 B, 1,317 B over ceiling. The per-dispatch worktree-isolation removal task's Move 2 MUST NOT trim (dropping the isolation/worktree_path forwarding-prohibition paragraph, now moot since no dispatch row carries those fields) plus a small wording-economy pass (one duplicate Context-References bullet, one duplicate aux_dispatch[]-reaches-Move-3 sentence, one tightened D4-exception lead-in -- no operational content removed) reclaimed 992 B, landing at 20,325 B measured via wc -c -- 325 B still over ceiling. 2026-10-01: a further duplication trim (collapsed the three Skill-to-Agent Mapping lifecycle-dispatch rows into one; reduced the detected_defects-never-prompts restatement in the Postflight Boundary section to a pointer back to Move 4's full statement; removed a Context References bullet that self-admitted '(see above)', duplicating the opening paragraph's own pointer to orchestrate-state-machine.md) reclaimed a further 332 B, landing at 19,993 B -- 7 B under ceiling. ceiling_bytes was left unmoved throughout.

commands/orchestrate.md.derivation: Original ROADMAP.md 'Budgets' target was 8,000 B; unreachable without relocating this file's ~10 KB STAGE 0 executable bash block, which is out of scope (a code-relocation change, not a documentation trim). Growth history: 15,812 B (2026-09-07) -> 19,967 B (2026-09-18, focus-prompt/forced-phase/cycle-budget documentation task) -> 20,228 B (2026-09-18, same-day sibling task's batch-orchestration-default documentation landing two more pointer lines) -> 21,328 B (2026-10-01, the `[HOLD]` status-marker change's STAGE 0 documentation landing, now 328 B OVER ceiling). Reviewed, dated ceiling move: 20,228 B + 500 B, rounded up to the next 500 B = 21,000 B -- that ceiling is now itself exceeded by the most recent growth. A restatement trim of the Options table's --fast/--research/--plan/--implement rows and the forced-phase Constraints bullet (duplicating docs/architecture/orchestrate-state-machine.md) remains available and is now the open finding a follow-up task should close before ORCHESTRATOR_BUDGET_GATE_MODE can promote to hard; this file was out of scope for the task that closed the other two findings (not in that task's file_scope).

eager_load.note: Regression check fails ABOVE baseline_bytes (via 'REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash scripts/measure-eager-context.sh --check', parsing the 'TOTAL: <bytes> B' line). baseline_bytes is a fixed recorded ceiling and must never be silently re-derived from a fresh measurement -- only a deliberate, reviewed change should move it. Re-measured during the per-dispatch worktree-isolation removal task (both immediately before and immediately after that task's edits, with an identical result): 67,980 B, 2,030 B over baseline_bytes. This overage PRE-DATES and is UNTOUCHED by that removal -- none of its editable files (verified live against measure-eager-context.sh's own per-file listing) are eager-loaded, so the removal could not move this figure in either direction. 2026-10-01: closed by a deliberate duplication trim across the predicted .claude/CLAUDE.md assembly's merge-sources/claudemd.md (the /orchestrate Command Reference row, the Multi-task syntax paragraph, and the Model Enforcement paragraph collapsed to short behavioural summaries plus existing/added pointers) and the eager rule agent-system/extensions/core/rules/git-workflow.md (two destructive-git narrative paragraphs relocated verbatim into context/standards/git-workflow-narrative.md, which is not eager-loaded) -- landing at 65,402 B, 548 B under baseline_bytes. baseline_bytes remains unmoved; every relocated clause was verified present in its new non-eager home before the eager copy was cut.
